description.narrative: The overall objective for conducting the MENA Regional Livelihoods (LLH) scoping study is to gain a comprehensive insight and evidence base into how the British Red Cross can have the greatest impact to improve the livelihoods of conflict-affected people in the Middle East. In this context, we will focus on both host and guest communities, returnees and refugees. Although the analysis will provide an overview of the capacities, opportunities, across Syria, Iraq, Lebanon and Yemen, there will be a focus on and recommendations for potential livelihoods programming in Syria and Iraq. The study will be led by the Global Surge team's FSL/LLH Adviser with the support of FSL/LLH team at BRC. Additionally, we will engage the expertise and institutional knowledge of LRC, a Movement partner, and Movement leader on livelihoods and therefore a strong asset to BRC in both analysis for this piece of work, and partnership on livelihoods. Ultimately, this scoping mission will allow BRC to assess if and how to invest further technical and financial resources into livelihoods programming in the Middle East region.
